question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Taciturn
solution:
The correct answer is '**Reserved**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Taciturn**' is '**Reserved**'.
 
• **Taciturn**: tending not to speak very much, in a way that seems unfriendly. [अल्पभाषी (अमित्रवत ढंग से); कम बोलनेवाला, चुप्पा]
 
 
• *Example: a **taciturn** and lonely young woman...*
 
 
 
• **Reserved**: shy and keeping your feelings hidden. (संकोची तथा मनोभावों को छिपाकर रखने वाला)
 
 
• *Example: She was quiet and **reserved** for a two-year-old.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Reserved.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Noisy**: making a lot of or too much noise; full of noise. (शोर मचाने वाला; शोर-भरा, कोलाहलपूर्ण)
 
• **Lively**: full of energy, interest, excitement, etc. (चुस्‍ती, रुचि, रोमांच आदि से भरपूर; जानदार, ज़िंदादिल)
 
• **Verbose**: using or containing more words than are needed. (आवश्यकता से अधिक शब्दों से युक्त; शब्दबहुल; शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण)
